title.narrative: Provision of Agroecology training and support in the roll out in Yirol East, Lakes State

description.narrative: The purpose of the support is to provide refresher training, field level advice, support and monitoring in order to facilitate adoption of agroecology in communities targeted by CTP’s Food Security and Livelihoods Interventions in South Sudan. Many communities are slowly embracing the Agroecological practices due to the different climatic changes. The support will be in a staggered way to enable the targeted communities grasp the different stages and give time for adoption. The is the second phase of the consultancy which will cover: - Review of recommendations from phase - refresher training for extension agents and some model farmers. - Designing monitoring and evaluation mechanisms to track the success of agroecological projects. - Identify key monitoring indicators that track the success of agroforestry projects during different implementation stages. - Support field officers in implementing agroecology monitoring tools. This will be a week in the field workshop planned for June 2023 when the farmers have already started implementing some of the practices adopted, it will be in form of technical backstopping on ground)
